title: BNY Mellon unit joins MiCA register as ESMA adds 15 providers

title: Soybeans Slump, Tracking Crude as US and Iran Pause Strikes
summary: Chicago soybean futures fell the most in more than two months as a pause in fighting between the US and Iran eased fears of further escalation, sending crude tumbling. Soybean oil is a key biofuel feedstock, and lower crude prices diminish its appeal.

title: Stocks, Bonds Rise in Relief Rally as Oil Tumbles: Markets Wrap
summary: A sharp retreat in oil prices triggered a relief rally in stocks and bonds after a lull in hostilities in the Middle East, starting a week packed with earnings and a stack of interest-rate decisions on a positive note.
